'''2010 US West Nationals Day 1 Shaun Janssen DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Shaun Janssen]] at [[2010 US West Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Jeretarius98
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
